limits: Neither an exponential sensitivity proxy nor its unity threshold is a physical mass-inflation measurement or a coordinate-independent local energy density.
Stationary Kerr κ− is a geometrically defined quantity with asymptotically normalized horizon Killing vector. A time-dependent perturbed interior does not retain exact stationary Kerr symmetry.
No outgoing flux, crossflow equation, stress-energy tensor, blueshift-local energy or Einstein backreaction are solved.
Power-law tail exponent is input. Different perturbation types and modes lead to different late-time decay laws; p=7 is not universal.
The late advanced-coordinate displacement cannot be identified with the observer's own short proper-time journey from Bound15.
Near-extremal χ→1, inner and outer horizons coalesce and limits can be nonuniform; χ=1 not sampled.
The χ→0 inner-surface-gravity formal limit is not a physical Schwarzschild inner horizon.
No statement is made about survival, an invariant zero core, quantum gravity, or a stable Cauchy horizon.
The 24! ring and 729 index are symbolic addresses and arbitrary sampling grids, not physical trajectories or time direction.
